 Print Ranveer Singh-starrer 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' has missed out on the 2027 Grammy nominations despite having eight entries submitted for consideration. The film's soundtrack, composed by Shashwat Sachdev , had been entered across several categories but failed to secure a nomination at the prestigious global music awards. The soundtrack, which gained widespread popularity across the Indian subcontinent, missed out in categories including Best Compilation Soundtrack for Visual Media, Best Song Written for Visual Media for 'Phir Se', Best Global Music Performance for 'Jaan Se Guzarte Hain' and 'Kanhaiyya', and Best Asian Pop Music Performance for 'Aari Aari'. Watch Saif Ali Khan Says 'Dhurandhar' Forced Bollywood to Rethink Music The film's remaining submissions were made under Best Dance/Electronic Recording for 'Vaari Jaavan', Best Pop Duo/Group Performance for 'Jaiye Sajana', Best Rap Performance for 'Destiny-Mann Atkeya' and Best Remixed Recording for 'Hum Pyaar Karne Wale'. However, India will still have a presence at the 2027 Grammys. Tamil track 'Varuvaaiy', by Devan Ekambaram and Susha, has earned a nomination in the Best Global Music Performance category. The recognition also makes it the first Tamil song to receive a Grammy nomination. Join conversation

 Meanwhile, British singer-songwriter RAYE leads this year's nominations with 11 nods, followed by Rosalia with nine. Ella Langley, Phoebe Bridgers, Miranda Lambert and Olivia Rodrigo have received seven nominations each. Bruno Mars, Leon Thomas and Olivia Dean have secured six nominations apiece. Beyonce has also created history by becoming the first artist to reach 100 career Grammy nominations. She achieved the milestone with a nod in the Best R&B Solo Performance category for 'Morning Dew (Donk)'. The 2027 Grammy Awards will be held on February 7, 2027, at the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles. Poll Vote & Share your view
